messages:
maya_ops: Heads-up — we started seeing a surge of GPU node provisioning failures in eu-west-1 around 02:20 UTC. Error surface: lots of KMS Decrypt throttles and nodes stuck in PROVISIONING.
liam_infra: Oof. Any infrastructure changes around that window? egress / privatelink / security group updates? @sunita_sec can you check audit logs?
maya_ops: We rolled a tighter egress policy to staging VPCs at 02:15 (deny all outbound except allowlist). It was a templated change; looks like a handful of infra tenants got the template applied by mistake.
ops-bot: deploybot: egress-policy-v2 deployed to eu-west-1-staging at 2024-11-06T02:15:07Z
zach_platform: Root cause theory: instance bootstrap calls KMS regional endpoint. If egress blocks the privatelink/keystore endpoint the SDK spins retries -> causes many concurrent Decrypt calls which trip KMS throttling on our account -> cascade and provisioning failures.
sunita_sec: This touches compliance — many Decrypt events in audit logs. Preserve logs immediately. @maya_ops save samples to S3 and snapshot any failed nodes.
jamal_sre: Side-effect: autoscaler sees provisioning failures and spins fallback capacity in us-east, increasing cross-region egress and cost. Metric snapshot: provisioning_failures.count x4, inter-region_egress.bytes +78% in 20m.
maya_ops: sample from failing cloud-init:
```
Nov 6 02:22:11 node-init[1234]: KMS Decrypt request failed: ThrottlingException
Nov 6 02:22:11 node-init[1234]: Retrying in 200ms (attempt 3)
Nov 6 02:22:12 node-init[1234]: Max retries reached, bootstrap failed
```
liam_infra: Short-term mitigation options: (1) rollback templated egress deny for infra tenants, (2) add explicit allow for KMS endpoints in infra VPC egress templates, (3) tweak bootstrap retry backoff to avoid synchronous retries.
zach_platform: Also consider a local ephemeral keystore cache in the bootstrap flow so we decrypt once per AMI boot and reuse until node ready. Add a circuit breaker on repeated Decrypt errors to fail fast.
sunita_sec: Any temporary IAM relaxations must be scoped and documented. We can create a 1h conditional allow for kms:Decrypt to role node-bootstrap-* with resource and region conditions. Compliance needs the incident ticket and preserved logs before any policy change.
maya_ops: Opening incident INC-20241106-007. Preserving logs to s3://redwood-audit/incidents/1720249200/ and snapshotting a failing node image.
jamal_sre: Action checklist (short-term):
- rollback templated egress rule for infra tenants (in progress)
- add KMS endpoint allow to egress templates for bootstrap flows (temp)
- suppress autoscaler cross-region fallback for 30m
- backfill audit logs to long-term bucket with 365d retention
liam_infra: Rolled back template at 02:40 UTC and verified node traffic to regional KMS is succeeding.
ops-bot: autoscaler: suppressed cross-region-fallback for group gpu-prod-eu for 30m
maya_ops: After rollback provisioning success improved from ~58% -> ~97% within 10m. Estimated one-off cost impact ~+$2.1k due to fallback and retry traffic.
sunita_sec: Filing compliance addendum for temporary IAM change and retention modification. Will attach preserved S3 logs and snapshot metadata.
zach_platform: Follow-ups for engineering: (1) prototype ephemeral keystore cache (2) bake egress allow for KMS into infra templates (3) reduce bootstrap retry aggressiveness (4) add alerting for KMS ThrottlingException spikes.
maya_ops: I'll create the postmortem draft and PRs for the fixes. Marking this thread for resolution once postmortem is posted.
liam_infra: Thanks for the quick rollback and containment. Ping if we need to escalate to SLA incident.
maya_ops: Closing thread: provisioning stabilized. Postmortem draft scheduled 2024-11-06T09:00Z, follow-up tracking PM-2174.
